sources: Connecticut Agricultural Experiment Station, House Centipede fact sheet (K. Washington State University Extension PestSense, House centipede: hunts flies, cockroaches, moths at night; https://pestsense.cahnrs.wsu.edu/fact-sheet/house-centipede/

beats.say: You just saw the thirty-legged bug in your bathroom.
Bites are uncommon, and usually only if you handle it or press it against your skin.
It eats bed bugs and baby cockroaches.
Squish it, and they all stay.
It has fifteen pairs of legs, and it uses them to chase.
It would rather run. It's one of the fastest things in your house!
